name: Manufactured received by Team
query:
select 

    se.posting_date as "Posting Date::120",
    se.work_order as "Work Order:Link/Work Order:150",
    se.name as "Stock Entry:Link/Stock Entry:150",
    se.modified_by as "Received By::160",
    se.owner as "Created By::160",
    se.fg_completed_qty as "QTY::60"
    

from `tabStock Entry` as se


where 

se.docstatus=1 
and stock_entry_type="Manufacture"
and workflow_state="Received"
and se.posting_date  >= DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
ORDER BY se.posting_date
